description: Ministry of  Tourism Development and Wildlife  -  Botanic Gardens (Admission Fees) - 2019 w.e.f. 01.07.2019
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by a minister under the Botanic Gardens Ordinance, establishing new admission fees and rescinding previous regulations. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters (creating new regulations, amending existing ones, and specifying legal requirements) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory content.
